{{Top|leg}}
The '''Zero-Gee Hall''' was a popular arena located on [[The Wheel/Legends|The Wheel]]. It was used for the [[Gladiators' Open]]. It was created by turning off the [[Artificial gravity generator/Legends|artificial gravity generators]] and lights, giving it the appearance of deep space. Floating planetoids in the arena were mines that were configured to explore either on contact or when someone came within close proximity of them.
